text:
Olivia: Weird one  drone dropped a small insulated box and a flat guitar case at the bike rack. No courier name on the label, just "Visitor: Eli Tan". Anyone expecting this?
Frontdesk Bot: Unidentified package logged as PRCL-7019. Drone delivery flagged. Security notified. Temporary visitor entry not created.
Kai: Not on my calendar. Drone deliveries are allowed but need recipient confirmation. Olivia, can you hold them?
Olivia: Yup holding beside the rack. The insulated box says "pastries" and the case is TSA-style, looks like a travel acoustic.
Melissa: Eli's a friend of mine! He said he might swing by after 4 for a short demo. I'll ping him.
Tony: Heads up that guitar cases can trip the scanner if we move them through the lobby. Suggest keeping them outside the main door in the bike alcove until verified.
Melissa: Eli confirmed via DM: "I'm five mins out, tell reception to print a visitor badge for Eli Tan, office phone 555-0199". Can we do temp badge?
Frontdesk Bot: Creating visitor profile: Eli Tan. Badge printed and on desk. Note: PRCL-7019 set to "hold until pickup". Drone box checked for food; items labeled as pastries, allergen info missing.
Kai: I'll go double-check box contents and take a photo to front desk thread. If it's pastries, let's refrigerate.
Olivia: Photo posted at front desk. Looks like croissants and a small note: "for the comms team". No allergens listed.
Tony: Okay fridge space in Break Room A. Moving pastries there now. Guitar case still in alcove, secured with cable.
Melissa: grabbing Eli from the street, will bring him in for sign-in. Please ensure badge auto-expire at 6pm.
Frontdesk Bot: Badge auto-expire set to 18:00. Locker D1 available for small items (code `2210`) if needed. PRCL-7019 tagged "drone delivery - verify recipient".
Olivia: Thanks everyone. Closing after Eli signs. Also note: security asked drone companies to include sender ID next time.
Melissa: Eli signed in at 16:12, picked up pastries and guitar. All good :thumbsup: 
Olivia: Thread closed. Kudos to Kai and Tony for quick triage. :clap:
